tasks.short: Collect each discipline's progress before the team meeting, lead the multidisciplinary meeting, write the agreed team plan, and consult therapists between meetings.

steps.what: Rehabilitation physician collects each discipline's progress notes before the team meeting
Rehabilitation physician consults with physical and occupational therapists and other professionals in the team meeting
Rehabilitation physician writes the agreed team plan
Rehabilitation physician coordinates with individual therapists between meetings

tasks.design: A team meeting view in the record ({OTHER}) shows each discipline's latest goals, functional scores and notes per patient, so the physician does not collect them screen by screen. The rehabilitation plan is one shared plan in the record with sections per discipline; the physician records the agreed goals there during the meeting. Leading the meeting and consulting therapists stay with the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress was collected from each discipline's notes and plans retyped after meetings.
tasks.enabler_now: Records show team views and shared plans per patient.
tasks.still_hard: Disciplines score progress on different scales.
tasks.human_edge: Getting the team to agree on one realistic goal.

evidence.claim: Records can show team views of goals and scores and hold one shared plan.
The dossier is kept twenty years after the last change.

assumptions: Boundary: from the team meeting due to questions settled; therapy itself is outside.
Input contract: disciplines record goals in the shared plan; fallback is collecting notes.
s3 is part of documenting treatment plans, which sibling task 29-1229.04:17201 covers; its saving is counted there, so s3 keeps its full time here.
research_questions: Is preparation time per meeting shorter?

incremental.description: Rehabilitation physician agrees shared scoring scales with the team.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small teams; high: large inpatient programs.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess the patient's needs, choose the device with the therapist, fill the device application, check it, send it to the insurer, and write the order for the orthotist.

steps.what: Rehabilitation physician assesses the patient's needs for adaptive equipment
Rehabilitation physician prescribes orthotic and prosthetic applications with the therapist
Rehabilitation physician fills the device application with medical justification
Rehabilitation physician checks the final application
Rehabilitation physician sends the application to the insurer by post or e-mail
Rehabilitation physician writes the device order for the orthotist

tasks.design: Device application forms in the record ({OTHER}) fill diagnosis, functional scores and earlier devices from the record, so the physician writes only the justification for this device. Once checked, the application goes to the insurer or municipality through their electronic channel. The device order for the orthotist uses a template per device type. Assessing needs and choosing the device stay with the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applications were filled by hand with data copied from the record and sent by post.
tasks.enabler_now: Records prefill forms from structured data; insurers take electronic requests.
tasks.still_hard: Each insurer and municipality has its own form.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing which wheelchair lets a patient get back to work.
tasks.altitude: The physician justifies instead of copying data.

evidence.claim: Records can prefill application forms from structured data such as diagnoses and functional scores.
Health data are special category data; sharing with insurers needs a legal basis.

assumptions: Boundary: from the function limited to the order written; delivery and fitting are outside.
Input contract: forms set up per insurer; fallback is paper.
Insurers handle electronic applications as they did paper.
research_questions: Do insurers ask for more information less often?

incremental.description: Rehabilitation physician reports form changes to the record team.

approvals.approved_version: The application as checked by the physician in s4.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: unusual devices; high: common devices with standard forms.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review the history and imaging, examine the patient, decide the diagnosis and treatment, and write the home exercise program.

steps.what: Rehabilitation physician reviews history and imaging across several screens
Rehabilitation physician examines the patient with a sports or repetitive-motion injury
Rehabilitation physician diagnoses or treats performance-related conditions
Rehabilitation physician writes the home exercise program by hand

tasks.design: A visit summary in the record ({OTHER}) shows the injury history, imaging conclusions and earlier treatment together. Home exercise programs are built from an exercise library with pictures and set doses, chosen per exercise and printed or shared in the patient portal, so they are not written by hand. Examining and deciding treatment stay with the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: History sat in several screens and exercise programs were written by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Exercise libraries print illustrated programs; records show summaries.
tasks.still_hard: Athletes need sport-specific exercises outside the library.
tasks.human_edge: Judging when an athlete can safely return to play.

evidence.claim: Exercise libraries can build illustrated home programs with set doses.

assumptions: Boundary: from the referral to the program given; physiotherapy is outside.
Input contract: exercise library licensed; fallback is writing by hand.
Diagnosis and treatment stay with the physician.
Priced here: the answer for sibling task 17203 does not cut writing the program. s4 keeps 40 because the physician still chooses and doses each exercise for the patient.
research_questions: Do patients follow printed programs better?

incremental.description: Rehabilitation physician adds sport-specific exercises to the library.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: complex injuries; high: common overuse injuries.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss patients with other specialists, schedule rehabilitation around tests and surgery, write rehabilitation orders, and track progress across disciplines.

steps.what: Rehabilitation physician coordinates rehabilitation services with other specialists
Rehabilitation physician schedules rehabilitation sessions around tests and surgery by phone and e-mail
Rehabilitation physician writes rehabilitation orders and referrals to therapists
Rehabilitation physician tracks progress across disciplines

tasks.design: Rehabilitation sessions are planned on the hospital's planning board ({OTHER}), which shows the patient's tests and surgery slots, so the physician does not arrange timing by phone and e-mail. Orders to therapists use order sets per condition. A progress view shows goals and functional scores per discipline over time. Discussing patients with other specialists stays with the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sessions were arranged by phone and e-mail, and progress was read from separate notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Hospital planning boards show all appointments; records hold order sets and progress views.
tasks.human_edge: Persuading a surgeon that rehabilitation should start earlier.

reach.learn: Whether sessions clash with tests less often.

evidence.claim: Hospital planning boards can show all of a patient's appointments; records hold order sets and progress views.
Systems that log staff planning can monitor staff and need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the shared patient to progress tracked; surgery planning is outside.
Input contract: tests and surgery on the planning board; fallback is phone.
Discussions with specialists do not change.

incremental.description: Rehabilitation physician moves sessions after emergency changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: outpatients with few tests; high: inpatients with many tests and therapies.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The rehabilitation physician keeps leading the team, assessing needs, diagnosing and coordinating with specialists; collecting notes, copying data into forms, handwritten programs and phone scheduling shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A physician with more time for patients.
